message:
Now I see it. `pktHeader.captured_length` is `uint32_t`. It's passed to `new uint8_t[pktHeader.captured_length]` and `memcpy(myPacketData, pktData, pktHeader.captured_length)`. 

But wait - `memcpy` takes `size_t` which is unsigned. So a huge `uint32_t` value would be a huge positive size, not negative. Let me look at `light_get_next_packet` in light_pcapng_ext.c to see how `captured_length` is set:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -n "light_get_next_packet" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus/3rdParty/LightPcapNg/LightPcapNg/src/light_pcapng_ext.c</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
